_comment: Descriptive JSON-shape schema for spell/ability definitions (data/spells/spell_database.json for slottable spells; data/spells/class_abilities.json for the per-class RMB ability mapping). A human-readable shape guide for validators/tooling, NOT a strict JSON-Schema document. The Rust omega-server / sim_core is the numeric authority: all spell damage and spawned world effects are server-authoritative, gated on Mana>=cost and cooldown, replicated via the ABILITY_EFFECT event — 'the client requests, the server decides'; spell files are a client mirror and the server wins on disagreement. Governing GDD doc: docs/systems/abilities.md (the four effect shapes + world-effect entity bands), docs/gdd/classes/index.md, data/schemas/projectile_schema.json. TODO: promote to formal JSON-Schema if the validators/ pipeline requires.

fields.name: string
fields.slot_eligible: bool — can this be slotted into action-bar slots 1-4 (vs a fixed RMB Class ability)
fields.acquired_from: string[] — glory_unlock | item | skill_tree (for slottable spells)
fields.predicted: bool — only movement abilities (Warrior Charge, Rogue Shadowstep) are predicted; everything else false

params._note: the standard parameter set; a parameterised spell is live-addable

fields.effect_id: string|null — VFX/SFX effect id broadcast in ABILITY_EFFECT

invariants: effect shapes: instant_aoe | spawned_world_effect | projectile_spread | movement
world-effect entities ride entity kind 3, id band 40000-49999 (healthorb 40000-42499, mine 42500-44999, dot-zone 45000-47499, bible 47500-49999)
a genuinely new behaviour (teleport/reflect) needs a rust/sim_core change + deploy
